game.title: Las Vegas Raiders at San Francisco 49ers

lede: San Francisco 49ers carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#2 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it San Francisco 49ers −11.5 with a fair total of 47.5, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is San Francisco 49ers pass offence vs Las Vegas Raiders pass defence, which sits +0.270 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.

The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: Las Vegas Raiders and San Francisco 49ers have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
